audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[].side reads "Skill" on all 7 rows while content win[] correctly gives Seraphine levels 1-5 and Nilah level 6, first item, and 2+ items. The two layers disagree.
audit.why: Nilah is melee-range early; Seraphine's Q/E poke her off CS through level 5. At 6, Apotheosis + Jubilant Veil dodge + Slipstream flip the all-in, and her healing/lifesteal-sharing carries her through items and teamfights.
audit.corrected: phases[0-3].side -> Seraphine, phases[4-6].side -> Nilah, ratings and whys rewritten to match (see edits).

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Jubilant Veil as matchup-defining but has no cooldown number (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Jubilant Veil is 26-22s, Slipstream is a near-instant 0.5s dash, and Seraphine's R is 160/140/120s. Naming these lets a reader time the all-in window instead of a vague 'check it before every step-up'.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags two applicable-but-unstated interactions: Nilah's shields (Joy Unending/Formless Blade/Apotheosis) absorb burst, and her sustain (Joy Unending P, Apotheosis R) needs Grievous Wounds timing.
audit.why: Both are real per her kit flags (shield, heal) and are not currently stated anywhere in the matchup text.
audit.corrected: Folded the anti-heal timing point into report[8].t (itemization) alongside the existing gender fix, since that field already discusses anti-heal timing generically; left the shield-absorbs-burst point in notes for a follow-up since no clean slot existed without expanding a field past the length band.
